title: On the Beach | Luxurious 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Beachside Seaside cottage steps from private beach access, with Gulf views, pet friendly stays, bikes, renovated baths, and walkable dining and shops.
description_expanded: Located south of 30A and just steps to the East Ruskin Pavilion, this two-story beach cottage boasts an exceptional location with terrific gulf views. Stairs to the living area are just off the entrance foyer. Vaulted ceiling with exposed beams, built-in cabinets, floor to ceiling windows that allow plenty of light, are just a few highlights of the living room. The living area extends onto the covered porch with amazing gulf views and spectacular sunsets. The unique dining table with iron base and reclaimed pine tabletop seats six. The galley kitchen is waiting for the family chef. Stainless steel appliances include Subzero refrigerator, Wolf gas stove, KitchenAid dishwasher, and a wine refrigerator. The breakfast bar seats four. Guest suite with king bed also on second level. The primary suite with king bed and ensuite bath are located on the first level west wing for privacy. The spacious second guest suite includes three custom built-in bunks plus a king size bed with storage beneath. Both guest suite and primary suite have access to a screened porch with a quick walk to the beach. The kiddos will race to line up at the outside shower after a day filled with fun building sandcastles. Two off-street parking spaces are provided. Park your car and enjoy a minutes' walk to beach and town square. On The Beach Features - Gulf View from the top floor covered balcony - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Beachside in Seaside, and less than a minute walk to two different private Seaside beach accesses. Access to all Seaside beach entrances included with your reservation - Complimentary Use of 3 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 1 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Town Center, with lots of shopping and dining options including the famous Seaside Food Trucks - Screened-in patio with outdoor dining table for 4 - Full kitchen on the top floor with stainless steel appliances including Wolf Oven and Range, SubZero fridge, wine fridge, and dual drip and Keurig coffee maker - Dining area on the top floor with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Gulf views from the living area on the top floor - Renovated baths - 1st Floor King Suite with private workspace. Perfect for remote working! - Cable and WIFI throughout the cottage. Smart TV in the bunk room - Outdoor shower - Dedicated parking for 2 vehicles. You will likely not need to get in your car until it's time to leave! Overflow parking available along 30A on a first come, first serve basis but we do not recommend you count on these spaces if your stay is during a busy season. -Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts -Concierge services including beach chair rentals, bike rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rentals available - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Area summer camps and kids' classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee The 30A area is continually growing and evolving. As a result, nearby construction, renovations, or public works projects may occur during your stay. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, these activities are beyond our control. Refunds or discounts cannot be offered for construction-related noise, disruptions, or changes in views. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, private entrance to screened-in patio, reach-in closet, private workspace with desk and chair, ensuite full bath with vanity and walk-in shower
1st Floor Bunk Suite | sleeps up to 5 in three twin beds plus one king bed, Smart TV, private entrance to screened-in patio, under-bed storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower, water closet which can be shut off from the bedroom as it is also available for the main living area

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
